main_block: [IMF-282 | Foam Roll, Quads] 60 seconds each side, slow and controlled passes to help your legs recover and stay ready for Friday.
[IMF-284 | Foam Roll, Glutes] 60 seconds each side, pause on any tight spots and breathe through them.
[IMF-283 | Foam Roll, Upper Back] 60 seconds, move from the mid-back up toward the shoulders.
[IMF-286 | Foam Roll, Lats] 60 seconds each side, roll from just below the armpit down toward the lower ribs.
[IMF-001 | Cat-Cow] 10 slow reps, match your breath to each movement and focus on full spinal motion.
[IMF-002 | Bird Dog] 10 reps each side, move with control and hold the end position for a count of two.
[IMF-007 | 90/90 Hip Switches] 10 reps each direction, keep your chest tall and let your hips do the work.
[IMF-297 | Breathing Drills, Box Breathing] 5 rounds, use this to settle your nervous system and finish the session feeling reset.
